# Patch Ticker

> A free, public, no-login board of security vulnerabilities, Korean first with English alongside. It is updated every 10 minutes from the CVE List, NVD, CISA KEV, oss-security, Hacker News, GitHub, security news sites and KISA, and tells a reader whether a new vulnerability touches something they run and what to do.

Each Incident (one row; it may hold several CVEs, or none yet) has a risk level set by rules, not by a model: exploited (CISA KEV, or a source that reports attacks) or CVSS 9.0 and up is "high risk", CVSS 7.0 and up is "elevated", everything else is a notice. Summaries in Korean and English are written by Claude from the linked sources only, and every Incident links to its official advisory.

## Data

Public JSON, refreshed every 10 minutes. Please fetch each file at most once every 10 minutes; bursts are rate limited.

- [Status](https://data.patchticker.com/status.json): when the data was last updated
- [Last 7 days](https://data.patchticker.com/board/recent.json): every Incident first seen in the last week, with risk inputs, products, summaries and source links
- [Last 7 days, light](https://data.patchticker.com/board/rows.json): the same Incidents as the week file, most without details (marked `rows`), for drawing the list
- [Months](https://data.patchticker.com/index.json): the months that have data; each month is at `https://data.patchticker.com/board/YYYY-MM.json`
- [Products](https://data.patchticker.com/board/products.json): product names seen in the last 90 days

## About

- [Site](https://patchticker.com/): the board itself (filters and search run in the browser)
- [Source code](https://github.com/dwamaker/PatchTicker): how the collector and the page work
- [Report a mistake](https://github.com/dwamaker/PatchTicker/issues): corrections come from readers

## Notes

- Summaries are AI-written from the sources; check the linked advisory before acting on them.
- CVE records: Copyright © 1999–2026, The MITRE Corporation, used under the CVE Terms of Use (https://www.cve.org/Legal/TermsOfUse).
- This product uses data from the NVD API but is not endorsed or certified by the NVD.
